source_printed_discrepancies.detail: Printed 6U Rules 13.2.13.2-2 and -3, not -1. Do not renumber.
6U slot identifier SLT6-SWH-16U20F and module option identifiers MOD6-SWH-16F20U are distinct in source and not independently reconciled to VITA original.
Printed conformance-method parenthesis is malformed before (A,T); do not infer extra scope.

exact_holds.reason: Original ANSI/VITA 65.0/65.1 3U/6U slot and module profile normative originals have not been inspected, only C239 native reference text.
Eight original C239 DSDM/IDL/OpenAPI source file bytes not independently examined.
Original figure caption/text inspected for two legacy profiles; visual page-image retrieval was unsuccessful; pin geometry not verified.
Legacy applies to standard PICP hardware profile; no inferred installed device age, functional health, maintenance status or decommissioning.
C239 Edition1.1 expresses intent for future removal but neither 2025 S251 nor subsequent adopted edition/removal date checked.
Grace period begins after actual removal of PICP; no inferred start date, expiry or current certification eligibility.
Recommendation not to use for new systems differs from mandatory 18-month grace and certification rejection AFTER actual removal/grace.
Three named 3U module profiles are source-cited valid alternatives for scoped legacy card, not installed components or external device data.
Legacy 6U Slot SLT6-SWH-16U20F vs listed MOD6-SWH-16F20U; original VITA mapping unavailable; cannot silently treat as typo/equivalence.
6U Rules are printed 13.2.13.2-2/-3 with no -1 in inspected scope; do not invent a missing Rule.
Only 3U radial clock -1 SMPM-10 dash designated legacy; do not extend to other dash-options or all clock cards.
None of four source cases is source-proven to use legacy SOSA PICPs, and no current supplier part/valid certification checked.
No final DIM class/field/cardinality, Profile SHALL, real hardware command, SAPIENT transition or interoperability claim adopted.
§13.3 AMPS begins on PDF252 but is outside G2-6D; excerpt source navigation is not clause audit.
